files=sorted(list(Path('main').glob('*.c'))+list(Path('main').glob('*.h')))

print('FILE_LINES')
for p in files:
    print(f'{sum(1 for _ in p.open()) :4d} {p}')
print('TASK_QUEUE_SITES')
for p in files:
    for i,l in enumerate(p.read_text().splitlines(),1):
        if any(x in l for x in ('xTaskCreate(', 'xQueueCreate(', 'xQueueCreateStatic(')):
            print(f'{p}:{i}:{l.strip()}')
print('EVENT_RECEIVE_SITES')
sites=[]
for p in Path('main').glob('*.c'):
    for i,l in enumerate(p.read_text().splitlines(),1):
        if 'gateway_event_receive(' in l:
            sites.append((str(p),i,l.strip()))
            print(f'{p}:{i}:{l.strip()}')
assert len(sites)==2, sites
assert any(p.endswith('gateway_events.c') for p,_,_ in sites)
assert any(p.endswith('gateway_transport.c') for p,_,_ in sites)
assert not any(p.endswith('gateway_uart_link.c') for p,_,_ in sites)
print('DYNAMIC_ALLOCATION_SITES')
alloc=[]
pat=re.compile(r'\b(malloc|calloc|realloc|free)\s*\(')
for p in files:
    for i,l in enumerate(p.read_text().splitlines(),1):
        if pat.search(l):
            alloc.append((str(p),i,l.strip())); print(f'{p}:{i}:{l.strip()}')
assert not alloc, alloc
allc='\n'.join(p.read_text() for p in Path('main').glob('*.c'))
assert 'xQueueCreate(' not in allc
control=Path('main/gateway_link_control.c').read_text()
assert 'GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_SNAPSHOT' in control
assert 'GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_PERMIT_JOIN' in control
assert 'GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_MEASUREMENT_POLICY' not in control
uart=Path('main/gateway_uart_link.c').read_text()
assert 'GATEWAY_LINK_SNAPSHOT_CACHE_CAPACITY' in uart
assert 'LINK_TX_QUEUE_DEPTH 16U' in uart
assert 'LINK_TX_TASK_STACK_BYTES 4096U' in uart
assert 'LINK_RX_TASK_STACK_BYTES 4096U' in uart
assert 'LINK_TX_ITEM_SNAPSHOT' in uart
assert 'gateway_link_snapshot_cache_update' in uart
assert Path('main/app_main.c').read_text().count('gateway_') >= 3
print('ARCH_INVARIANTS=PASS')
